# Mandatory service.configure Linux observations

The canonical Linux guest manifest now requires the exact 25 reviewed service.configure observations: 20 parent tests, four named child controls and the actual filesystem golden child. This extends the unchanged 123 race observations and four separate native package observations to 148 race and 152 total requirements. Historical models subtract only these fixed service IDs; the current validator requires every observation. The three existing optional cases, package phase, worker 22 checks and PostgreSQL 80 requirements remain unchanged.

The service golden child reuses the existing owned `/opt/zenith-file-write-golden` fixture after file.write cleanup. Its result must be generated by the actual Linux handler and compared through the existing golden diff/status steps. No result artifact was authored here. Missing, failed, skipped, duplicate, malformed, zero and unobserved outcomes fail; deleting source files does not remove the fixed requirements. Five new report models exercise those contracts and bind the six reviewed Go test source hashes.

Scope: service controls use real Linux filesystem/intent custody with modeled systemctl effects. They do not prove an installed systemd service, default signed daemon delivery or full service lifecycle. Source authoring and mechanical patch checks only; compiler, model tests, actual Linux execution and genuine golden generation remain unrun by this author. Root must run the two changed CI suites, execute the complete native Linux gate, inspect the generated service artifact and obtain independent source review before publishing this packet. The service implementation and golden source files are read-only dependencies, outside this four-path registration patch.
